description: This file declares exported API functions for the BroadWay Service Delivery System's Broadway Web Resource Manager (BWRM) component, specifically for managing cooked pages. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initiating cooked page objects, serving as an interface between implementation source files.

methods.name: BwrmCreateCookedPage
methods.description: Creates a cooked page object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwrmCpoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BWRM Cooked Page Object with given contexts.

methods.name: BwrmCpoRemove
methods.description: Removes/destroys the specified cooked page object.

methods.name: BwrmCpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols or registers necessary objects within the cooked page object.

methods.name: BwrmCpoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the cooked page object, setting up its internal state.
